fields: L5 Shanghai / Dragon Boat Festival (e-bike; Lujiazui → the Bund → Huaihai Road → Xintiandi). Same item fields as L3 v3.1 / L4. Pools keep L3 names so pickSetL2 + l3TypeUniq can be reused: seawall = 端午摊 Zongzi Stall questions (3–4 choices, timed 30 s; also the retry pool), forest_fork = fork signs (≤3 choices; sign_en/sign_zh; EN ≤24 chars, ZH width ≤12), peak_final = Xintiandi-entrance final (exactly 4 choices, hard, situational). Per run: 3 timed stall in segment 1 + 4 fork in segment 2 + 2 timed stall and 1 Xintiandi final in segment 3 = 10 (one stall pool, drawn as 5 then split 3+2; do not place all 5 timed questions in the first segment). Every item has qtype + qtype_zh (each qtype at most once per run). {name} = player name; English on top, Chinese below. No subject capybara/beaver. Festival riddles are object/animal riddles solvable in both languages (subject 'riddle'), labelled Festival riddle: / 端午谜：. Stems are deduped against all L1–L4 banks (all grades).

questions.subject: safety
questions.q_en: Why is riding an e-bike while watching a phone especially risky on a busy Shanghai street?
questions.q_zh: 在上海热闹的街上边看手机边骑电动车，特别危险，是因为____。
choices: plane trees turn off all shade
phones make the motor more powerful
the river will rise at once
attention and reaction time drop, so you may miss people or a light
choices_zh: 电机会因为手机变得更有力
注意力和反应变慢，可能看不见人或灯
questions.explain_en: Looking at a phone takes your eyes and mind off the road.
questions.explain_zh: 看手机会让眼睛和注意力离开路面。

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: The number of zongzi in a stall puzzle solves 2x² - x + 8 = 0. What is the discriminant b² - 4ac?
questions.q_zh: 一道摊位题里的粽子数满足 2x² - x + 8 = 0，判别式 b² - 4ac 是多少？

questions.subject: language
questions.q_en: Li Sao is a long poem by ____.
questions.q_zh: 《离骚》是谁的长诗？
questions.explain_en: Li Sao is by Qu Yuan.

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: The number of zongzi in a stall puzzle solves 5x² + 9x + 2 = 0. What is the discriminant b² - 4ac?
questions.q_zh: 一道摊位题里的粽子数满足 5x² + 9x + 2 = 0，判别式 b² - 4ac 是多少？

questions.subject: language
questions.q_en: At Xintiandi the doorman says the welcome line on the wall is from Li Sao. Li Sao is ____.
questions.q_zh: 新天地的礼宾说，墙上那句迎客的话出自《离骚》。《离骚》是____。
choices: a tide chart for the Bund
a long lyric poem by Qu Yuan
questions.explain_en: Li Sao is Qu Yuan's long lyric poem, often remembered around this festival.
questions.explain_zh: 《离骚》是屈原的长篇抒情诗，过端午时常被人提起。

questions.subject: science
questions.q_en: On the Bund's wet stones, Flora brakes her e-bike and notices she needs more room to stop than on dry Huaihai Road. The main reason is ____.
questions.q_zh: 外滩石板是湿的，Flora 骑电动车刹车时发现，要比在干的淮海路上留出更长的距离才能停住。主要原因是____。
choices: plane trees add extra mass to the bike
lower friction on the wet surface
the doorman is pulling the bike forward
wet stone makes the motor stronger
choices_zh: 梧桐会给车子加上额外的质量
潮湿地面上的摩擦更小
湿石头会让电机更有力
questions.explain_en: Water reduces friction between the tyres and the stones.
questions.explain_zh: 水会减小轮胎和石板之间的摩擦。
questions.qtype_zh: 力与运动（摩擦/阻力/牛顿定律）

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: Lamp posts along the Bund carry flags in an arithmetic pattern: 11 on the first, 19 on the second, and so on. How many flags are on post 11?
questions.q_zh: 外滩灯杆挂旗成等差：第 1 根 11 面，第 2 根 19 面，依此类推。第 11 根有多少面？
questions.qtype_zh: 等差数列第 n 项

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: At Xintiandi, 9 zongzi are set out, and the number set out doubles every minute. After how many minutes are 36 zongzi set out?
questions.q_zh: 新天地先摆出 9 只粽子，摆出的粽子数每分钟翻一倍。几分钟后摆出 36 只？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: Zongzi at Xintiandi are set out in rounds: 6 zongzi in the first round, then 3 times as many each round, for 5 rounds. How many zongzi in total?
questions.q_zh: 新天地的粽子分轮摆：第一轮 6 只，之后每轮是上一轮的 3 倍，共 5 轮，一共多少只？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: At Xintiandi, Flora may pick 3 of 6 different zongzi to share. Order does not matter. How many different sets can she pick?
questions.q_zh: 在新天地，Flora 可以从 6 只不同的粽子里挑 3 只分享，不计顺序，有多少种挑法？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: Zongzi are set out in waves at Xintiandi: 9 at first, and the number set out multiplies by 3 each wave. How many are set out in wave 7, after 6 multiplications?
questions.q_zh: 新天地的粽子一波波摆出：开始 9 只，每一波是上一波的 3 倍。乘了 6 次之后（第 7 波）摆出多少只？
questions.qtype_zh: 指数增长/衰减求值（翻倍、等比）

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: Flora has 48 m of five-color thread to fence a rectangular zongzi area at Xintiandi. What is the largest possible area in m²?
questions.q_zh: Flora 有 48 米五彩绳，要在新天地围一块长方形放粽子的区域，最大面积是多少平方米？
questions.qtype_zh: 最值优化（定周长最大面积）
